scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build:apk: npm run version:sync && vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../ElectionSurvey-debug.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ~/Downloads/ElectionSurvey-debug.apk
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run version:sync && vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../ElectionSurvey-release.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ~/Downloads/ElectionSurvey-release.apk
scripts.test:api:all: deno test -A --no-check deno-deploy/api_test.ts deno-deploy/helpers_test.ts deno-deploy/field_test.ts deno-deploy/integration_test.ts deno-deploy/stress_test.ts
